Seen • Just now
Yes, we do offer price matching for price drops that occur after your purchase!
Here's how it works:
Price Match Policy:
If the price of the same item is reduced by Avocado or by an authorized retailer within 30 days after your purchase date, we'll refund the difference to your original form of payment. This applies only to future price reductions that occur after your purchase — not to lower prices, promotions, or discounts that were already available when you placed your order.
Requirements:
The item must be identical in model, size, and color, and in stock at the time of the request
The lower price must be publicly advertised and verifiable
Only offers from authorized retailers qualify (no auction sites, marketplaces, or unauthorized resellers)
You must contact our Customer Experience team within 30 days of your order date and provide proof of the lower advertised price
If a promotion occurs shortly after your purchase and results in a lower price, you're encouraged to contact our support team to discuss potential refund options.
